title: 第19章 我圣人境的修为被发现了第20章 两情相悦喜事临门
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: 经过一番打闹，聚贤楼的聚会也全散了，毕竟伤的需要治疗，赢的得意风发离开。
更重要的是林琅天给众人记住了，君家神子为了妹夫，吊打三大圣子为题材故事，在君家盛传。
回去途中，林琅天与君傲天并肩而行。
“君大哥实力傲视群雄，今后君家小辈将再也不会出现不服的声音，小弟恭喜君大哥了，今后君家年轻一辈将以你为首”。
“你真的这样想吗？我觉得不一定”君傲天大有深意的看着林琅天。
“咳咳，君大哥干嘛这样看着小弟”林琅天被君傲天看的浑身不自在。
心中却是心思翻腾：“莫非君傲天发现了什么，不应该啊，从头到尾自己都隐藏的死死的”。
快走到庭趣阁时，君傲天拍了拍都林琅天的肩膀，人离开时留下一句：
“我只有一个要求，好好对待小雪”。
看着君傲天离开，林琅天停留良久，苦思不明，自己在哪里暴露了。
“叮咚，宿主笨死了，只要君傲天不是傻子，都能发现你的异常”。
“系统，你意思是？”林琅天一副虚心求教的样子。
“宿主，你想想，半路被截杀，谁在君傲天身边？”
“是我吧”
“系统：今天爆发的冲突，又是谁最靠在君傲天身边”
“也是我”
“那你这个表面上是废物的人，为什么啥事都没有？”
“我……”林琅天一时语塞；
回想起来当初情况：“生死境的冲突余波何其强大，众多公子哥实力强的运功抵挡，实力弱的早退的远远的”。
“系统：宿主你稳坐钓鱼台的看戏耶！是头猪都知道你有问题”。
“我靠，我忘了这茬了”
圣人境实力的林琅天，有自动护主的圣光存在，任何有威胁性的攻击一旦靠近，就会自动消弥掉。
“看来君傲天早就起了怀疑之心，今天这一幕是建立属于他的威信，恐怕也有试探自己的原因”
“实力强大，心机深沉，君家神子果然不简单啊”后知后觉的林琅天不由感叹；
content_en:
After a lot of fighting, the party at Juxian Tower also broke up. After all, those who were injured needed treatment, and those who won were happy to leave.
What's more important is that Lin Langtian has made everyone remember that the story about the Jun family's divine son beating up the three holy sons for his brother-in-law is widely circulated in the Jun family.
On the way back, Lin Langtian and Jun Aotian walked side by side.
"Brother Jun is arrogant in strength. From now on, there will never be any dissatisfaction among the younger generation of the Jun family. Congratulations to Brother Jun. From now on, the younger generation of the Jun family will be led by you."
"Do you really think so? I don't think so." Jun Aotian looked at Lin Langtian thoughtfully.
"Ahem, brother Jun, why are you looking at me like this?" Lin Langtian felt uncomfortable when Jun Aotian looked at him.
But thoughts were swirling in his heart: "Could it be that Jun Aotian discovered something? It shouldn't be. He has been hiding it from the beginning to the end."
When he was about to reach Tingqu Pavilion, Jun Aotian patted Du Lin Langtian on the shoulder, and left a message when he left:
"I only have one request, treat Xiaoxue well."
Watching Jun Aotian leave, Lin Langtian stayed for a long time, wondering where he was exposed.
"Dingdong, the host is so stupid. As long as Jun Aotian is not a fool, he will be able to detect your abnormality."
"System, what do you mean?" Lin Langtian looked like he was asking for advice humbly.
"Host, think about it, if you were intercepted and killed on the way, who would be by Jun Aotian's side?"
"It's me"
"System: In the conflict that broke out today, who is closest to Jun Aotian?"
"Me too"
"Then you, a seemingly useless person, why does nothing happen?"
"I..." Lin Langtian was speechless for a moment;
Looking back on the original situation: "The aftermath of the conflict in the realm of life and death was so powerful. Many young masters with strong powers resisted, while the weak ones retreated far away early."
"System: Host, just sit back and watch the show on Diaoyutai! Even a pig knows there is something wrong with you."
"Holy shit, I forgot about this"
Lin Langtian, who has the strength of a saint, has the holy light that automatically protects him. Any threatening attack will be automatically neutralized once it approaches.
"It seems that Jun Aotian has long been suspicious. Today's scene is to establish his prestige. I'm afraid there is also a reason to test himself."
"With great strength and deep scheming, the divine son of the Jun family is really not simple." After realizing it, Lin Langtian couldn't help but sigh;
title_en: Chapter 19: My cultivation in the saint realm was discovered Chapter 20: Two people are in love and happy events are coming
